name: Visit Pass / Tourist visa

requirements.blocker_text: This requires showing you'll leave Singapore at the end of your visit.
This requires showing sufficient funds for the visit and return journey.

evidence_required.document: Evidence of sufficient funds and intent to leave

outcome.duration_length: up to 30 or 90 days depending on nationality, at immigration officer's discretion

notes: Many nationalities (including most countries already covered in this dataset) are visa-exempt for short visits, only needing an application if their nationality requires a visa. Duration granted (30 vs 90 days) is genuinely at the discretion of the immigration officer at entry, not a fixed guaranteed figure by nationality alone — worth flagging as a real element of uncertainty distinct from the more codified duration rules seen on most other countries' visitor routes in this dataset. No single-bloc equivalent to the Schengen system — each visit to Singapore is assessed on Singapore's own terms, the same structural point already flagged on Australia's and Japan's visitor routes relative to the European Schengen model.
